body:
# Independent native05 cove source-to-world review

2026-10-12 JST. Candidate: `native05-authored-cove-corner-v3`. Fixed fixture: `authored-flower-reference-mature.json`, with p6=(7,-1), p7=(9,-1), p9=(8,0). This review found no source-level issue that should stop integrating this fixed candidate. It does **not** establish an app, visual, use-flow, or whole-island acceptance result. App and authored source files were not edited; no browser/GPU run was performed.

## Frozen identity and materials

Paths below are under `docs/design/2026-10-12-authored-cove-entrance/`:

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `cove-corner-v3.glb` | `f08ada4907c76a617e2c22090049b9b2880dde2d75fa11ad61f6e76c7eec7146` |
| `cove-corner-with-apron-v3.glb` | `81b1ff0bf9d050d5c78d40d21ee4a664d8e7088feacd082f6c91c5e86a235a6c` |
| `cove-corner-with-apron-v3.blend` | `52b3a24c79ada053728ca55d2c2fb7b86f6954e5e77164a375434446f2952696` |
| `shared-apron-world-patch-v1.json` | `66294123a26f6e4ecb8af2e530aee7e59370d3495bf3c9e4447376ce4fc6c3bc` |
| `assembly-manifest.json` | `092e21cee39bad1f386cf446e3b6901bcdd275f34583da6e4e51a384875dfbf9` |

These are the final material-aligned files, not the earlier combined export. Independent comparison found the shell geometry and all shell material definitions unchanged between shell-only and combined GLB. Pearl/violet transmission remains approximately .72/.69. Apron top is #ccc9d4 and bank #bbb8c7, with corresponding linear glTF color values, roughness .8 and metallic 0.

The adopted `2026-10-10-island-final-3d/whole-island` original GLB, Blender file and benchmark image retain their known hashes: `8398eda9…`, `d1c7bb07…`, and `9de26a7f…` respectively. Full hashes are in the audit JSON. Author `source-continuity.json` records preserved source regions and frame joins; this review did not independently repeat every Blender Boolean/curve topology check.

## Geometry parity and single rendering contract

The independent GLB reader applies complete parent/node transforms. Its apron extraction contains 331 top triangles, matching the patch indices/topology after nearest-vertex correspondence. Maximum exported vertex difference is 4.252e-7 world units. The combined export preserves the separate shell geometry.

There is one explicit numerical exception: patch top triangle 330 is almost collinear (original upward area 1.482e-11). GLB Float32 coordinates reverse its winding, producing a downward area of 6.708e-10 near x=6.487,z=-.548. Thus 330/331 top triangles remain upward. This is a negligible export sliver, not exact coordinate/winding identity; it does not create a meaningful supported-route gap in the patch floor. This exception was disclosed to root and author; no model rework was requested.

Integration should render the shell-only GLB and render the apron from the composed world's floor/surface geometry exactly once. Do not also display the combined GLB apron. The combined GLB is source/evidence, not a second floor draw. Source material parity does not prove runtime GLTFLoader, transmission, or shader behavior.

Common transform: source GLTF pivot (13.9,.89,1.2), authored position (8,.0475,.5), uniform scale .45 and yaw 0. Source Blender→GLTF is (X,Z,-Y). Renderer coordinates subsequently subtract `layout.center` from X and 2 from Z; Y is unchanged. Apply node matrixWorld, pivot, uniform TRS and renderer offset once each. The floor patch is already in authored-world coordinates.

## Existing ground, navigation and width support

The patch was independently applied to compiled base world and the current water-composed world. It preserves old floor definitions, anchor floors, old site prefixes and old edge prefixes. Both retain 73 build grants and add exactly 13 walk-only refs / 15 edges. Four refs append to existing districts via `siteAdditions`; nine belong to the new patch district. These are not new owner cells.

The added apron is one valid polygon with area 2.471875235544728 and 331 triangles. Boundary-fill difference is 0. Overlap with original dry ground is only 2.143e-12 area, numerical tolerance. Ground boundary distance is 0 and the shared boundary length is 4.600923. The 329 checked seam vertices differ in height by at most 1.416e-5 world units. This establishes a connected plan footprint with negligible seam-height differences; it does not assert bit-identical seam coordinates or validate every rendered sidewall.

The actor envelope exactly equals the actual c5 screenshot report's indexed-source-motion-interval envelope: 117 meshes / 99,868 vertices from pokomoko plus eight friends, all at .45 scale, including motion intervals. Radius .24406937059140585; height .5500928879753579. Every one of the 15 added edges was checked with a conservative edge AABB expanded by radius+.04 = .28406937059140586. Added+existing floor union leaves zero uncovered area for all 15 boxes, in both base and water-composed worlds. This is continuous planar width support, not just center-point support.

## Shell obstruction, houses and structural contact

All 79,384 shell/frame/socket triangles were explicitly included in the actual actor-band obstruction algorithm through a diagnostic eligible-root wrapper. The current flower-only root selection must be generalized in production; omitting shell triangles would invalidate a route result. Both base and water worlds exclude 37 walk refs. Reachable approaches are p6=2, p7=7, p9=6; of these, direct source-guard-clear approaches to the owner are p6=2, p7=4, p9=5. Production must select a clear final approach, rather than assume every adjacent ref reaches the owner.

An independent hierarchy plus full triangle SAT, including coplanar axes, checked actual shell/frame/socket geometry against the original home-cap geometry at actual p6/p7 layouts (.45,.5625,.45 home scale). At 1e-8 world tolerance, 89 broad-phase candidate pairs produce zero intersections. This is a fixed-house surface-intersection test, not a universal layout guarantee or a proof about every future added decoration.

Structural support was checked beyond author vertex-only grounding: all 192 downward socket-bottom GLB triangles were intersected with actual water-composed dry-floor triangles. Their total projected area is .312497213. Clipping each overlap by the affine condition groundY−bottomY >= 0 and unioning admissible regions leaves at most 5.450e-17 area without contact, numerical tolerance. Thus there is no meaningful floating bottom region in this fixture.

Do not claim uniform .006 burial or a .003 minimum everywhere: the stricter .003-depth coverage test leaves up to .000212964 area uncovered in one bottom triangle. Highest-floor depths sampled at 7,972 overlap vertices range .003018–.007695 world units; that sampled minimum is not a proven continuous lower bound. The raw JSON minimumDepth=-.028096 considers buried lower overlapping terrain planes, not the highest support surface, and must not be read as a floating failure. The continuous contact-union test is the relevant non-floating result.

## Water scope and outstanding integration evidence

The actual water frame used revision `authored-water-v2:3c5f4ee9f492cc25:eb41954202b1926a` with owners l22,l21,l20,l23,l24. This independently covers the current fixed candidate over that water-composed world, including floor/nav preservation, full width and cove source obstruction. Other water arrangements or moved owner layouts remain unverified.

Still required in the app: hash-verified loading and source-material rendering; composed-world/source transform parity; combined flower/cove/other obstruction eligibility; preview/commit parity with committed actors retaining their canonical physical world during ghost preview; cancel, move, separation, store/reload and removal of shell plus patch sites/edges/floor together; actual walk→play→exit and carry/drop/receipt use; whole/close/rotated/phone visual checks. This source review does not advance those gates or establish whole-island completion.

## Reproducible evidence

All diagnostic paths are under `/private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-plan/`:

- `independent-audit.mjs` / `independent-audit.json`: source hashes, full-transform parsing, triangle parity, fixed house SAT, compiled-world invariants and source obstruction.
- `independent-floor-audit.py` / `independent-floor-audit.json`: planar unions, conservative widths, seam samples and continuous socket contact. Shapely 2.0.7 / GEOS 3.11.4.
- `independent-floor-input.json`: actual compiled ground, edge and exported socket inputs for that diagnostic.
- `independent-material-audit.json`: complete shell-material equality and final apron colors.
- `independent-input-provenance.json`: final manifest/Blend/fixture/world/report hashes and equality with the actual c5 actor envelope.

body:
# Native-05 P04 — low shell, entrance and shared shore

2026-10-12. Current visual assembly **`native05-authored-cove-shore-v4`**. The shell itself keeps source ID `native05-authored-cove-corner-v3` and its original verified bytes. **Art HOLD, independent comprehension/safety HOLD (N=0), broader runtime acceptance incomplete. M1 remains open.** [Actual app integration through c4](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/README.md) is stored separately from these source inputs.

The first actual c1 whole/close views made two homes and the low entrance readable, but exposed a pale rectangular apron protruding into the sea. v4 replaces that outline with a broad asymmetric bowed shore, continuing the existing grass and sand materials. The shell, houses, owned positions, 13 walk-only refs and 15 edges stay unchanged. [c4 actual app screenshots](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/c4/contact-sheet.html) confirm the rounded shore through move/store/restore, rotation and 390/768 widths. Whole-island art remains HOLD.

| Transfer | Do not transfer |
|---|---|
| Native violet pearl shell, curved ribs, tapered half-vault and grounded runners | A high roof concealing both homes or unowned benches |
| A real open corner leading to the current play target and dry court | A painted doorway, floating cut ribs or invisible floor |
| The native uniform `.45` transform and continuous rounded coast | Stretched proportions or a rectangular display platform |

The spatial action is: enter through the open corner, cross the same dry court, and use the existing play target. These source checks are not actual app rendering, natural acquisition, independent observers or whole-island approval. Normal production remains false-default; integration is explicit DEV `cove=corner`.

## Current source handoff

| Artifact | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Shell GLB](cove-corner-v3.glb) / [editable shell](cove-corner-v3.blend) | Unchanged v3 shell, continuous entrance rim and terrain-fitted runner sockets; the only cove GLB delivered at runtime |
| [Combined v4 GLB](cove-corner-with-shore-v4.glb) / [editable v4 assembly](cove-corner-with-shore-v4.blend) | Same shell plus the exact shared-ground top and closed bank, for authoring and parity checks |
| [Assembly manifest](assembly-manifest.json) | Separate visual/shell identities, coordinate/material contracts, topology and current hashes |
| [Shell source manifest](source-manifest.json) | Unchanged native-05 hashes, opening dimensions, shell topology and source transform |
| [Current world patch](shared-apron-world-patch-v1.json) | v4 visual geometry in the existing v1 patch schema; one added floor/bank district, four original-ground site additions and walk-only edges |
| [Feasibility](feasibility-with-shore-v4.json) / [full-width support](full-width-support-v4.json) | Author checks of actual source triangles, original owners and conservative route-width support |

Shell SHA is `f08ada4907c76a617e2c22090049b9b2880dde2d75fa11ad61f6e76c7eec7146`. The current patch is `7a5cc9edd5282f7471f8257e4ee83212cbf93f3f30ba269bb102d91bc11dc969`; combined v4 GLB is `ff79d2bff518cbd94a5ef2a5566e5f24ed09296248bd538c7fa41a475f849077`. Approved native-05 GLB remains `8398eda9ac084a6e80ed22f1a82670c380b017544a177106325aaa7ba7f8f68d`.

## One transform, one floor

Exported source coordinates follow Blender `(X,Y,Z)` → GLTF `(X,Z,-Y)`. Subtract GLTF pivot `(13.9,.89,1.2)`, multiply uniformly by `.45`, then add authored position `(8,.0475,.50)`, yaw `0`. Only the renderer subtracts `layout.center` from X and `2` from Z. The world patch is already authored-world geometry. Combined source export uses the inverse of this transform; Float32 GLB serialization must be compared with an explicit tolerance.

Runtime renders the shell-only GLB and the WorldDefinition floor/bank **once**. The combined source is never added on top of the same world floor. Existing dry triangles are subtracted from the new outline and remain unchanged. The v4 added area is `4.7649456086` world², with bounds X `6.04625–10.28500`, Z `−.917327–2.584374`. The top has 598 vertices / 596 triangles. The closed source has 1,196 vertices / 2,388 faces and no boundary/nonmanifold edges.

Top color `#a4cb87` and roughness `.95` match the current runtime grass floor. The original native terrain roughness is `.78`, as recorded in the [separate normal/material audit](../2026-10-12-authored-whole-massing/floor-normal-audit/README.md). Bank color `#e2d7c9` and roughness `.78` match the native pale sand coast. Source colors convert sRGB to linear glTF values. The shell's original four materials and transmission remain unchanged. The wider outline requires the runtime profile's audited ground/clearance window to cover the whole new shore; reusing the old Z `2.25` limit is insufficient.

## Bounded geometry and lifecycle evidence

The `.043`-thick shell was cut as a closed solid with a rounded arch. Its continuous frame joins the retained runner, jamb and opening into the back arch. The far shell surface, five ribs, five seams and right runner remain native source geometry. Runner sockets contact the actual local ground. No new house, bench or owner is added. The shell contains 18 source nodes / 19 loaded primitives / 79,384 triangles.

The current p6 `(7,-1)`, p7 `(9,-1)`, p9 `(8,0)` and supply l32 `(8,-2)` retain their audited models and maturity. The patch adds nine refs in its own district and four refs on original floor, with 15 walk-only edges. Placement grants remain 73; no join or water rights are introduced. The author's full-width check unions actual dry triangles and covers each added edge's AABB expanded by actor radius `.2440693706` plus `.04`. Maximum numerical uncovered area is `1.303e-13`.

These are fixed-arrangement source results. The application must derive shell, floor and routes together, reject unaudited nearby changes, and remove or restore the assembly after move/store/separation/reconnection. It must preserve committed actor and pointer support during preview. The [c1 focused integration](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/focused-integration/README.md) verifies that lifecycle on the previous rectangular patch; it is not v4 verification. The [final v4 independent source audit](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/source-v4-independent/README.md) passed 17 gates. The [v4 focused tests](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/focused-v4/README.md) and [c4 core/full journey](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/c4/core-full-archive-proof.json) provide separate application evidence.

The author's current exact planar audit reports old-floor overlap only at numeric area `5.153e-13`, continuous socket contact and maximum seam-vertex height delta `.000545293`. GLB top/bank vertex error is approximately `4.252e-7`; near-collinear triangles can reverse after Float32 export. Their areas and counts are recorded in the author audit, not silently omitted or called exact winding identity. Uniform 6 mm burial across every socket face is not claimed.

## Visual status and preserved history

[Corner](source-corner-v4.png), [interior](source-interior-v4.png) and [overhead](source-overhead-v4.png) are Blender Workbench **source geometry** views. They do not reproduce final native transparency or game lighting. The [c4 runtime review](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-runtime/c4/art-review.md) separately compares actual whole/close/rotated/390/768 screenshots beside the approved benchmark. Author magnetism and silent safety remain HOLD until those respective gates are met.

The [v3 rectangular-apron bundle](history/v3-rectangular-apron/) preserves the prior source before v4 changes. Its [earlier independent audit](independent-audit/independent-source-review.md) remains v3 evidence, including the one Float32 top sliver. The corner-only v1 disconnected p6/p9, and v2 sockets intersected p7's step at two triangles; their original failures remain under `history/`. The first v4 curve left a p6-side width gap, then a too-small verification crop failed; both remain in `history/v4-first-shore-gap/`. Later contour revisions change source shape before freeze and do not count as passed app iterations.

Reproduction uses `build-shore-footprint-v4.py`, `probe-cove-shore-v4.mjs`, `verify-floor-support-v4.py`, `build-assembled-shore-v4.py` and `render-source-preview-v4.py`. Blender is `/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender`; the bounded planar helper uses Shapely 2.0.7 / GEOS 3.11.4 in the temporary geometry environment. These are source-authoring tools, not new app dependencies. Raw execution logs retain same-byte `.log.txt` copies so fixed snapshots include them. Runtime/core/browser reports belong in the sibling `authored-cove-runtime` folder, outside this source collector.

3. Apply the explicit deletion list, then extract the two delta members over that tree. The delta SHA is `b999ba7820860a4a7405d414917b5cf1dc8d32e884fc4511f72c4ab7b332ef7f`.
4. Enumerate and hash the reconstructed tree. Its complete file set and all hashes must equal this folder's `inputs.json`.
5. Recheck all original c2 parts, source proof/closure/snapshot records, and the fixed c4 candidate inputs. They remained unchanged during this run.

The actual temporary reconstruction was `/private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-c4-source-recovery/reconstructed`. The temporary verification script was `build-recovery.py` in its parent directory. It was run with Python 3 and exited 0; no core/build/browser/regression command was started by this operation. The archive reconstructs the declared input closure, not node_modules, generated outputs, or every file of the full checkout.

`artifact-hashes.json` covers this folder's evidence files and excludes itself to avoid circular hashing. No original c2 evidence or archive part was modified.

# c4 — 入り江の局所実装と回帰検証

## 結果

runtime 証拠は source 入力の `authored-cove-entrance` と別の sibling folder に置く。source folder 内の JSON は driver が再帰的に hash するため。raw log は内容を保った `.log.txt` として保存し、`*.log` の ignore 対象にしない。

- 共通 apron の実頂点・描画 triangle 数・raycast 床高を照合。元の床、73 配置権、32 所有物を保持する。

title: 本体接続の範囲と仕様同期
label: 本体接続の範囲と仕様同期
body:
# 本体接続の範囲と仕様同期

主目的は、低い殻・入口・共有岸を同じ所有物の場所として描画し、配置予告・確定・歩行・利用で同じ世界を使うこと。現在は明示DEV候補で、通常の本人保存への切替ではない。

`authoredWorldFrame` は不変の基礎worldから水庭、殻の支持床、最終placeを順に計算する。実際の家のstyle／成熟、あそびば、水供給、配置、局所床が監査済みprofileに合う場合だけ殻を組み立てる。配置や成立条件が変われば、殻と追加床／歩行点／辺を一緒に消す。すでに追加床を含むworldを次の基礎として使わず、追加床だけで成立条件を満たす循環を拒否する。

殻はSHAを照合した原本派生GLBの19 primitive／79,384 trianglesを使う。元の法線と4素材、入れ子のtransformを保持し、一度だけ共通座標へ移す。床はWorldDefinitionから一度描くため、床を含む確認用GLBはruntimeへ重ねない。共同形の選択先は元のp9で、新しい所有IDを作らない。

予告では将来のworldを別に計算する。現在のactor・pointer支持床・所有物は確定worldを保つ。変化する殻だけ一時非表示にし、取り消すと同じgeometry／material／rootを戻す。初期previewを伴う再構築で衝突判定が消える不具合は、表示上の一時非表示と確定worldの物理可視性を分けて修正した。無効な配置や取消しで予告床を残さない。

歩行判定は花庭と殻の実三角形を同じactorの部位別余白へ照合する。殻だけの場所でも働き、通行・利用・退出・drop／cancel／床の消失による退避に適用する。全ownerへの接近、実あそびばへの歩行／利用receipt／退出、予告と確定の同じ床・transformはfocused検査を備える。ブラウザの全旅程は別の証拠として検証する。

## Doc Sync

- [原本部品と所有の契約](../../product/island-native-owned-art.md)へ低い殻・連続する入口／支持・可視の共有床と丸い岸を先に追記した。
- [検証matrix](../../ai/verification_matrix.md)へ殻単独／花庭混在、全owner接近、利用／退出、移動／収納／再接続、予告取消と確定world分離、固定sourceの既存回帰を追記した。検証免除は作っていない。
- 52の取得／価格／成熟規則、13の保存schema、学習仕様は変更しない。配置権73と元の所有物を保持し、追加する点／辺はwalkだけを許可する。
- [包括方針](../../product/island-construction-strategy.md)と既存ADRを具体化する作業で、新しいADRやdurable memoryは追加しない。
- active taskと共有queueはM1未完を保持。c1〜c3の失敗と、c4の固定core／全編集旅程PASS、美術HOLDを分けて記録する。既存5回帰はその生結果に従う。

## Review

独立したコード確認は、previewを保持して全景へ戻った後に殻のguardが抜けるP2を1件検出した。修正前の実テストで0 triangles、修正後は79,384 trianglesを記録し、取消後も安全な床へ戻る。その他の確認対象にP0–P2は認められなかった。レビューだけで本体全旅程や美術採用を保証する判定ではない。

c2の全旅程で、許可された移動先 `(4,-4)` が主路を占有して24 ownerへの接近を断つことを確認した。移動前後で水庭と床は同じで、元位置に戻すと接近が回復する。driverを安全な `(12,-9)` と実geometryの事前検査へ修正し、両方の移動先をlife回帰で保持した。c3では復元期待値を検査用JSONから再構築したことによるプロパティ順の指紋差を確定した。保護対象の値が初期stateと同一であることを確認して初期stateを期待値に使うようdriverだけを直した。アプリの指紋規則は変更していない。c4で選択・取消・移動・収納・復元と回転／両幅の全旅程が通り、各失敗の生記録も保存した。

現在の実形状guardは花庭と殻を対象とする。[全native樹木とl14の入口の調査](../2026-10-12-authored-whole-massing/l14-approach-audit/README.md)で見つかった候補探索とguard対象の不足は、次の中央肩／森の制作で扱う。今回のPASSを全樹木・全施設の自然利用へ拡張しない。

子ども向けの新しい説明・失敗評価・学習ノルマは追加していない。内部ポータルの別担当ファイルを編集せず、以前の花庭・水庭の変更も保持する。最終の検証結果はこの説明ではなく、固定候補の生の実行記録で判定する。

# P04の殻・入口・共有床 — 本体への接続

最新の固定候補c4はcore606 files／5,265 testsと入り江の全編集旅程がPASS。[実画面シート](c4/contact-sheet.html)に全景・近景・回転・390幅・768幅の10画面と予告画像を保存した。殻の実選択、予告取消、通路を保つ移動、収納、元位置への復元を同じ32所有物／家8軒／73配置権で確認した。[入力と実行証拠](c4/core-full-archive-proof.json)の2,137 core入力とdriverの2,012入力は前後一致し、driverは同byteのsubset。[既存回帰の初回結果](c4/regressions/README.md)は島編集・水庭・通常Growing・classicの4件PASS。花庭の初回900秒上限による未完了を保存したうえで、外側上限のみ2,400秒に変更した[同入力の再実行](c4/flower-full-retry-2400/verification.md)が12画面・4canvas選択・4編集・若い／成熟入力までPASSした。これで既存5回帰が揃った。全体の範囲と限界は[c4検証記録](c4/verification.md)にまとめる。

[作者の実画面評価](c4/art-review.md)はdesktop38/60、390幅35/60、768幅34/60をそれぞれHOLDとする。丸い岸は矩形台座を解消したが、中央の裸丘と薄い森、均一な地面、tablet全景の余白が残る。次の制作は[中央丘肩の実支持・入口と森林](../2026-10-12-authored-whole-massing/next-production.md)。[c4 sourceの復元](c4/source-recovery/README.md)と[通常falseの配布境界](c4/build-boundary/README.md)も保存した。rawモデルの通常配布除外は確認したが、床JSON／JS adapterは残るため全native dataの除外とは呼ばない。

c1の実全景と近景では、高い大屋根を低い殻へ置き換え、二軒の屋根と入口が見えるようになった。一方、矩形の床が台座に見えたため、c2では殻のbyteと所有物を保ち、既存岸に接する丸い草地へ改稿した。[c2の実全景・近景](c2/contact-sheet.html)で矩形台座の解消を確認。全島の作者評価は38/60、別agentは35/60で、どちらも美術HOLD。

c2固定coreは606 files／5,263 tests・lint／typecheck／build／asset budget PASS。2,137入力が開始終了一致し、[入力archiveとSHA](c2/core-archive-proof.json)、[core log](c2/core/execution.log.txt)、[通常false配布境界](c2/build-boundary/README.md)を保持する。raw GLB/gzip/Blenderは通常配布に含まないが、coveの床／nav JSONとJS adapterはbundleに残る。全dataの除外や実SW更新を証明したとはしない。

c2の全browser旅程は実殻選択と予告取消を通過した後、p9を(4,-4)へ移した時点で24 ownerへの接近が不成立となりFAILした。[失敗画面と生記録](c2/full-first-failure/report.json)を保存し、[実geometryの診断と回帰](target-diagnosis/README.md)で移動先(4,-4)が主路の19歩行点を占有したと確認した。同じworldでp9を元位置へ戻すと全32ownerへ接近でき、水庭と継続床は不変。配置許可を全島通行保証と取り違えたharnessの前提を修正し、通路を保つ(12,-9)を事前確認する。l20〜l23のdryFloor=falseは初期の成功画面にもあり、新しい床消失の証拠ではない。

c3固定coreは606 files／5,265 tests PASS、2,137入力の開始終了一致を確認した。[coreと最初のbrowser失敗](c3/core-full-first-failure-proof.json)、[base＋QA二ファイルの復元archive](c3/source-recovery/README.md)、[通常false配布境界](c3/build-boundary/README.md)を保持する。実画面では殻選択・予告取消・(12,-9)への移動と32 ownerの接近・収納まで通過した。元位置への復元予告のID待ちでタイムアウトし、[生記録と実画面](c3/full-first-failure/report.json)を保存した。[純粋診断](target-diagnosis/c3-recovery/README.md)で、検査用JSONから消えたundefinedのcellキーを末尾へ戻すと、全stateの値・床・経路・殻が同じでも検査期待値の指紋だけ変わると確定した。実アプリの予告／復元IDは初期IDと一致する。保護したstateの不変条件を確認した後、初期state自体を復元目標にするようdriverを補正し、c4の全編集・回転・390/768幅で再検証した。失敗したc3の記録は上書きしない。

- [c1実画面と美術評価](c1/art-review.md)：固定DEVの2画面。全編集旅程・390/768幅は未実行。
- [実geometry／利用のfocused検査](focused-integration/README.md)：2 files／13 tests PASS。初期previewで衝突判定が消える不具合を再現し修正した。
- [実装の範囲・仕様同期・レビュー](implementation.md)。
- [c1実行証拠](c1/archive-proof.json)：2,068入力を凍結し、browserの1,961入力が同じhashのsubset。入力tarと初回core失敗を保持する。

c1のcoreはdocs段階でFAIL。c6検証記録の二つのリンクがgitignore対象の `.log` を指し、非ignoreファイルから作った固定コピーにログが入らなかった。ログ内容を保った `.log.txt` のdurable copyとリンクへ修正した。c1でlint／unit／buildまで通ったという意味にはしない。

現在のvisual candidateは共有岸の改稿を含む `native05-authored-cove-shore-v4`。殻だけのsource IDは `native05-authored-cove-corner-v3` とSHAを保持して区別する。[v4 focused 5 files／30 tests](focused-v4/README.md)と[独立したsource検査](source-v4-independent/README.md)はPASS。全編集旅程の失敗はc4で解決した。5回帰を同じ固定入力へ照合し、入り江の局所実装と対象runtime検証を閉じた。本人取得・自然成熟・保存／offline・性能・独立観察・公開は未達。

title: Independent v4 shore audit
label: 入り江と岸の制作・確認
body:
# Independent v4 shore audit

PASS for the source/floor/domain checks recorded in [summary.json](summary.json). This is not browser, core, visual, or complete actor pose/lifecycle acceptance.

The author explicitly froze the v4 patch, combined GLB, editable Blender source, and assembly manifest before input collection. This audit independently decoded those GLB bytes, compiled the actual domain frame, measured current actor rigs, and ran the planar floor kernel. It did not copy the author's numeric results. The kernel was adapted from the earlier fixed c1 independent audit.

- Visual candidate: `native05-authored-cove-shore-v4`; shell source: `native05-authored-cove-corner-v3`.
- The unchanged shell, transform, delivery gzip, and combined shell geometry/materials match. The earlier shell/home intersection result is carried only because those bytes and transform are unchanged; this run did not repeat the full shell/home SAT comparison.
- Base and water composition preserve every original floor, anchor, site, edge, source identity, and all 73 placement grants. All 2063 existing site supports remain identical. The patch adds exactly 13 walking refs and 15 walking edges.
- The current domain frame equals independent additive patch compilation in both modes. GLB top 596 triangles and bank 1196 triangles match the patch; maximum vertex serialization error is `4.251159422060467e-7` world units. The 2388-triangle combined shore has 0 boundary edges and 0 nonmanifold edges.
- Nine actual fixture actors, 117 meshes and 99868 indexed source vertices give walking radius `0.24406937059140586`; the sweep uses radius plus `0.04`. All 15 routes have maximum unsupported area `4.3133129806609846e-14`, below the recorded `1e-12` planar tolerance. All 192 actual socket-bottom triangles retain contact within numerical tolerance.
- The old eligibility window did not cover the new shore. Root widened localGround and clearCourt to min `(5,-3.5)`, max `(11,3.5)` with base/water fingerprint `b854fd9d1de0c4d9`. Current source and actor sweep bounds fit. The earlier custom-profile test retained the fixture and rejected an extra owner at `(10.7,3.1)` that the old bounds accepted. Pre-fix evidence is retained in `before-profile-fix/` and `bounds-audit.json`.

## Explicit numerical limitations

Three nearly collinear GLB top triangles have non-upward orientation after Float32 serialization (largest area `1.0519057550928499e-7`). Their minimum altitudes are at most `1.8887918123272132e-7`, below measured vertex serialization error. All triangles are retained and both floor materials are double-sided. This is recorded rather than silently deleting geometry or claiming every top normal points up. Maximum sampled seam height delta is `0.0005452929999999988` world units; this check uses a `0.001` height tolerance.

## Reproduction and provenance

The exact commands run from the project root were:

```text
node /private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-v4-independent/audit.mjs
/private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-entrance/geometry-venv/bin/python /private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-v4-independent/floor-audit.py
node /private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-v4-independent/bounds-audit.mjs
python3 /private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-v4-independent/finalize.py
```

`audit.mjs` produces the floor input before the planar check; the durable copy compresses that input as `independent-floor-input.json.gz`. Decompress it beside `floor-audit.py` to replay only the planar audit. The scripts record the original repository and fixed-c1 paths explicitly. Dependencies were the repository's Three/esbuild and Shapely 2.0.7 / GEOS 3.11.4.

`initial-inputs.json` and the final raw report contain exact before/after hashes; closeout verifies all 64 collected inputs still match. `artifact-hashes.json` checks this archive's files and excludes itself to avoid a circular hash. Outputs live in the sibling runtime evidence directory, outside source input collection.

The first harness attempt failed because it looked up `bank.color` instead of `bank.material.color`. The raw failure and initial hashes are retained. Only the harness was corrected; no app or source edits were made by this auditor.

title: c3 restoration preview revision diagnosis
label: 詳しい資料
body:
# c3 restoration preview revision diagnosis

The c3 full browser run failed while waiting for the restore preview's expected revision. The recorded UI already exposed the initial revision and one visible prospective cove shell. Pure computation from the exact recorded inputs confirms that the driver waited for a different, deterministic revision produced only by its JSON-round-tripped expected state. The original full run remains **FAIL**; no browser rerun occurred in this diagnosis.

| Input and operation | World revision |
| --- | --- |
| Initial browser baseline | `authored-world:72a57599a43ddca5` |
| Stored state, reconstructed through real move and store commands | `authored-world:063fdbf4bf1fb7e6` |
| Actual UI preview from in-memory stored state | `authored-world:72a57599a43ddca5` |
| Driver future: JSON-parsed stored state, then append `cell` | `authored-world:aa54694380b082d1` |
| Actual preview helper given that same JSON-parsed state | `authored-world:aa54694380b082d1` |
| Pure real unstore command on in-memory state | `authored-world:72a57599a43ddca5` |

The store command assigns `cell = undefined`, retaining its original property position in memory. The dataset's JSON serialization omits that key. When the driver parses the dataset and assigns `cell`, it appends the key after `stagedAt`. `deriveAuthoredCovePlan` fingerprints the complete plots array with `JSON.stringify`, so property insertion order changes the cove revision even though the plot values match. `previewGrowingState` preserves an existing cell key's position through object spread.

The real-command reconstructed stored state serializes **byte for byte identically** to the recorded failure state. UI future and driver future have equal values across **all state fields**, with no value-different fields. Their water plans, cove assemblies, floors and sites are also equal. Only the property order and resulting cove/world identity differ. The actual preview metadata matches the in-memory computation, while the driver's expected revision does not. More waiting cannot resolve this equality predicate.

The driver's preceding `protectedState(stored)` invariant already proves that every canonical value except p9's cell matches the baseline. Under this fixed journey, using `structuredClone(baseline)` as the restoration target preserves the original key order and initial-plan/revision assertion. No production fingerprint change is needed to correct this diagnostic expectation. This focused investigation found no evidence of an additional application failure; it did not audit all persistence or serialization flows.

## Evidence

- [Pure computation report](report.json): exact revisions, all-state/value and geometry comparisons, plus **90 local production/resource inputs** matching browser initial and final SHA-256.
- [Exact browser input](exact-input.json): recorded baseline, stored failure state and failure metadata, with source report SHA.
- [Executed diagnostic script](diagnose.mjs) and [raw output](execution.log.txt): actual `applyIntent`, `previewGrowingState` and `authoredWorldFrame` functions from the fixed c3 candidate.
- [Archive manifest](archive-manifest.json): raw byte-preserving copy and file hashes.

The scripts retain their executed `/private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-c3` paths; the c3 candidate and deliberate path remapping are needed to reproduce them elsewhere. Generated temporary module bundles are rebuildable and omitted. No app, driver, candidate, previous evidence, browser, core or production build was changed or started by this diagnosis.

title: c2 distant-p9 target diagnosis
label: 詳しい資料
body:
# c2 distant-p9 target diagnosis

The failed browser edit moved p9 from `(8,0)` to `(4,-4)`. That is a legal play placement, but it closes an existing main-route neck. It does not delete existing composed terrain. The browser's all-owner assertion remains necessary for its safe edit journey; the destination must satisfy that journey's stronger accessibility assumption.

## Evidence

- [Exact recorded browser input](exact-browser-input.json) retains the baseline, failed state, metadata and source report SHA. The original browser run remains a FAIL.
- [Pure domain report](domain-report.json) isolates occupancy from floor composition: water floors are identical, only the expected cove apron disappears, and every retained floor is unchanged. Applying the original occupancy to the exact failed world reconnects all 32 owners. At `(3.5,-4.5)`, the removed walk ref had neighbors `(3.25,-4.5)` on the home side and `(3.5,-4.75)` on the far side. The p9 placement removes 19 walk refs around the neck. l20–l23 already reported `dryFloor: false` in successful baseline captures; those values are not a new floor loss.
- [Actual geometry report](physical-report.json) loads the fixed c2 GLB, native kit, flower support and 9 real character rigs. The measured envelope exactly matches the browser. All compared obstruction/access counts match both browser baseline and failed captures. All 103 loaded local production/resource inputs match the browser's initial and final hashes.

| State | Triangles | Walkable | Reachable | Owners unreachable |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline p9 `(8,0)` | 115808 | 1410 | 1386 | 0 |
| Failed p9 `(4,-4)` | 27648 | 1438 | 181 | 24 |
| Requested alternate p9 `(12,-9)` | 36424 | 1432 | 1417 | 0 |

The one requested alternate was checked without searching other placements. All 32 owner routes use actual world neighbors and pass the real geometry guard's `clearGroundPath`. This is a grounded choice for the safe journey, not permission to weaken its owner-access assertion. Restoring p9 returns the expected cove assembly; the different triangle totals in separated states reflect the actual remaining flower composition.

## Regression verification

The owned [life test](../../../../src/components/island/growing/authoredCoveLife.test.ts) now covers the real move to `(12,-9)`, store, and unstore at `(8,0)`, checking all placed owners after every life sync. A second case checks the legal blocked destination, retained floor identity, the same-world occupancy control, and access recovery after moving back. No fabricated use receipt is introduced. Production behavior was not changed.

- [Single targeted life run](targeted-life.log.txt): 1 file / 8 tests PASS, 56.39 seconds.
- [Targeted ESLint raw output](targeted-eslint.log.txt): exit 0, empty output.
- [Invocation/exit evidence](targeted-execution.log.txt), [verification report](targeted-verification.json), [before hashes](targeted-inputs-before.json), [after hashes](targeted-inputs-after.json): 285 inputs, 0 changes during the run.
- Test SHA-256: `27cd7b4575e74d66b1386184c83a579b86708bdeb64ce027632b9a17211adab4`.

[Summary and file hashes](report.json) distinguish the fixed c2 diagnostic inputs from the new local regression test. No browser, full core, or production build was launched by this diagnosis. The scripts preserve their executed absolute c2 candidate and temporary paths; reproducing them requires the same candidate or deliberate path remapping. Raw `.log.txt` files were copied byte for byte, not transcribed. Temporary generated module bundles are rebuildable from the scripts and are omitted from this archive.

title: 原本床の法線・材質を保持する候補
label: 原本床の法線・材質を保持する候補
body:
# 原本床の法線・材質を保持する候補

2026-10-12。**固定c1で原本抽出・物理データの同一性と、実画面5組のA/Bを確認。全島美術はHOLD。** [元の監査](../2026-10-12-authored-whole-massing/floor-normal-audit/README.md)を受け、床を同じまま原本NORMALとroughness／metalness／両面性を保持した。分離作業コピーで準備した変更は[肩の候補c1](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/README.md)へ取り込み、固定した入り江c4は変更していない。

[新しいworld](native05-world.json.gz)は10床／50,180頂点の法線を保持する。[物理比較](physical-parity.json)では追加した描画属性と描画revisionだけを除くと、元のWorldDefinitionと全項目が一致した。89,488三角形、73配置地点、全歩行点／辺／地区／原本SHAを保持する。これは抽出データの結果で、切削後の陰影や実画面の評価ではない。

[抽出時のmanifest](world-manifest.json)に原本と実行入力のSHA、新gzip／展開後のSHAを保持する。[実行したextractor](source-extractor.mjs)は分離コピーの `tools/build-authored-island-world.mjs` と同byte。[stdout](source-extraction.log.txt)は実行toolが返した出力を同じ改行で保存したもので、独立したterminal logのコピーではない。exit 0 を確認した。[archive manifest](archive-manifest.json)に保存時のSHAと、保存用heredocが実行前に文字コードエラーとなった最初の記録も残す。入力は固定c4から作った次工程のコードコピーであり、未実行のcoreをPASSとは扱わない。

描画側は元法線を読み、水切削の新頂点へ線形補間する。新しい水底・岸へ原本草地の法線をコピーせず、属性なしの既存床は再計算と現在の材質を保つ。法線の修正で床・indices・権利・通行を変えず、殻の物理profileはcell／point／三角形を照合する。描画cacheは新revisionを使う。[全樹木guardと組み合わせた草稿検査](focused-draft/README.md)は10 files／94 tests、対象eslint error 0でPASS。その後の固定c1のcoreは610 files／5,296 tests、typecheck／buildまで通過した。

## 同じ32所有物の実画面A/B

[生report](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/c1/regressions/01-floor-shading-ab/actual/report.json)は1280×900の全景・回転・l14近景、390×844と768×1024の全景をlegacy/sourceで各1枚、計10枚／5組。肩を無効にした同じ32所有物・73権利・昼・reduced motionで、camera、所有・成熟・時計、物理的な歩行／全owner接近、app versionの一致を確認した。実versionは `authored-shoulder-c1:3fd164b9-6f32-4502-9ca5-dde6c5c1cbd7`、明示DEVのnative／coveはtrue、通常配布native=false、fresh contextでSW登録／制御なし。人物の時間に応じた描画位置は同一に固定しておらず、画像のpixel一致試験ではない。

[原記録13ファイルの保存証明](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/c1/regressions/01-floor-shading-ab/archive-proof.json)は9,064,759 bytesをbyte同一で保持。driverの1,909入力はcoreの6,398入力と同byteのsubset、外側runnerは全sourceと6つのinstalled dependencyの前後一致を確認した。

作者が5組を視認した。[近景legacy](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/c1/regressions/01-floor-shading-ab/actual/1280-hill-close-legacy.png)と[近景source](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/c1/regressions/01-floor-shading-ab/actual/1280-hill-close-source.png)では、中央丘の三角形状の濃い縞が弱まり、面が滑らかになった。一方で細い点線状の境界は残る。陰影の全原因を解消したとはしない。スマートフォン幅での差は小さく、薄い森・中央と右の空白・角張った道・768幅の大きい海の余白も変わらない。

これは描画属性の比較であり、肩の35所有物の美術・取得・編集結果とは分ける。全島の森林構図、独立理解／安全N=0、M1と包括ゴールは継続する。


## c2で細い線の原因を分ける

全8回帰を通過した固定c2へ、アプリのファイルを変更しない[実rendererの診断](c2-causal-diagnostic/index.html)を行った。同じ32所有物・l14近景・1280×900で、床だけが影を受けない設定にすると大きな影は消えたが、細い点線状の境界は残った。続いて同じ床を照明の影響を受けない材質へ一時変更すると、その線は見えなくなった。カメラ・光・geometry・normal・color・indices・物理状態と歩行は各比較内で不変だった。

この結果は線がlit shadingに依存することを示すが、法線のみが原因と断定しない。照明のない表示を修正として採用せず、法線や材質の境目を調べる。各診断後、元のmaterial・shadow flag・Scene hookを復元し、一時material2個を破棄した。6,460 local入力・6 installed依存・driver/browser依存は前後一致。[34 filesの原記録](c2-causal-diagnostic/archive-proof.json)は圧縮を展開したbyteまで同一で保存。47.713秒／52.799秒は診断の実行時間で、製品性能ではない。美術HOLD・独立理解N=0・M1未完を維持する。

[静的な追跡](c2-causal-diagnostic/static-normal-audit/README.md.txt)では、細線の一部に対応する急な尾根の細長い三角形を特定した。source床だけのrayでは、面法線がカメラへ向く一方、補間された原本法線は逆向きとなる。対象部分の共有辺で法線断裂は見つからず、元床のPBR設定も共通だった。これは一部の線に対する候補原因であり、全細線や実rendererの原因確定ではない。[8 filesの保存証明](c2-causal-diagnostic/static-normal-audit/archive-proof.json)と[対象座標・入力SHA](c2-causal-diagnostic/static-normal-audit/candidate-cause.json)を保持する。次の診断は実bufferの対応座標を先に照合し、小領域の陰影用法線だけを一時変更して復元する。床形状や歩行は変更しない。

現在配置された水庭によるruntime切削と、原本にすでに彫られた水路は区別する。対象点を抽出時のscale／originで原本へ戻すと、native lower flowの近くになる。原本の[地形生成](../2026-10-10-island-final-3d/mature-island.py)は細分化した地形全体へsmooth shadingを設定し、[水庭の制作](../2026-10-10-island-final-3d/varied-world.py)は水路付近を追加細分化して頂点を彫っている。現在のruntime水庭が別位置であることは、原本の水路制作と無関係である証拠にはならない。

その後の[実rendererの小領域比較](c2-causal-diagnostic/roi-review.html)では、実bufferと原本の2三角形を照合した上で、対象域だけ陰影用法線を面法線へ一時変更し、元へ戻した。同じ近景の対象域では110画素が変わり、復元後は差分0だった。作者の視認では細線のごく一部の濃淡だけが変わり、細線全体は残る。局所の法線応答は確認したが、修正を採用せず、原因全体の解消とも扱わない。[作者の判定・元PNGのSHA・画素比較](c2-causal-diagnostic/roi-root-review.json)を残す。

最初の試行はprojectionの`-0`と`0`の比較でcapture前に停止し、原値を残して符号付きゼロのみを正規化した2回目は3枚と不変照合を取得した。ただし2回目も最終エラー検査は`favicon.ico`の404で**FAIL**。除外や再ラベルはしていない。[原記録45 files](../2026-10-12-authored-shoulder-runtime/c2/floor-diagnostic/roi-attempt-02/README.md)はその失敗も保持する。camera／geometry／normal buffer／材質復元／歩行不変の限定証拠と実行全体のFAILを区別する。製品美術HOLD・独立観察N=0を維持する。

title: 花庭の枝先と席の縁：c6実画面評価
label: 花庭の枝先と席の縁：実画面評価
body:
# 花庭の枝先と席の縁：c6実画面評価

2026-10-12、制作経緯を知るエージェントによる内部評価。**36/60・美術HOLD**。最終の12実画面を確認した結果で、c6-shapeの2枚による暫定評価を全旅程の受入へ読み替えたものではない。独立した理解／安全の観察は **N=0**。全島M1と美術の包括受入は未完である。

採用目標は[native05原本の全景](../2026-10-10-island-final-3d/whole-island-render.png)。[前候補の近景](../2026-10-11-authored-flower-garden/runtime-c4/desktop-flower-close-day.png)と[全景](../2026-10-11-authored-flower-garden/runtime-c4/desktop-mature-whole-day.png)、[今回の比較と全12枚](contact-sheet.html)を画像として比較した。前候補と今回の成熟画面は同じ合成32所有物／8軒の入力を使う。採用原本は所有数・構図・照明が異なる完成目標であり、同一条件のpixel比較ではない。

## 評価対象と実画面の識別

| 項目 | 確認値 |
| --- | --- |
| 実target | `http://127.0.0.1:5353/prototypes/place-qa/authored.html?water=wide&reference=preflight32` |
| build revision | `authored-flower-edge-c6` |
| visual candidate | `native05-authored-flower-garden-v3` |
| 配布条件 | DEV authored診断。`VITE_ISLAND_ENABLED=true`、全12枚の実rootは`nativeGrowingArt=true`、`growingFeatureEnabled=true`。通常buildのnative artはfalse |
| 実renderer | 本体のGrowingWorld。単独のasset viewerではないが、通常製品の起動・学習・本人保存の経路ではない |
| world definition | `native05-authored-world-m0-v2` |
| 原本source SHA-256 | `8398eda9ac084a6e80ed22f1a82670c380b017544a177106325aaa7ba7f8f68d` |
| 花庭support | `native05-owned-flower-support-v1` |
| 固定入力 | 保存された合成32所有物／8軒。`mature-32.frame.json`のstate hashは`0593897ea073f817fbdee7f445491ccde12b9e2c083542aa19d320454c40cd2a` |
| browser／cache | ローカルの新規headless browser context。service worker・offline・更新経路は未検査 |
| 一次証拠 | [実manifestを含むreport](runtime-c6/report.json)、[sourceと画像の照合](runtime-c6-proof.json) |

全12枚のbuild、candidate、delivery属性は一致している。原本sourceとruntime入力のhashは別の識別値である。runtimeの開始／終了入力hashはともに`e26e7d77e8d9050b5fc54b4a7b64887d3b832086501421f497dbe7c2cf80dcec`。

## 六軸の評価

以下の各点は **candidate `native05-authored-flower-garden-v3`／2026-10-12／証拠種別：実runtime PNG／確信度：中**。viewportは各行のリンクと次表で特定する。コード・テスト・到達可能性を美術の加点に使わない。

| 六軸 | 点／10 | 実画面での判断と主な証拠 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 入りたくなる世界 | 6 | 大きな一輪と、その下から席へ伸びる植物の関係は現れた。原本のように森・家・道・入り江が連続する生活空間には届かず、中央と右の斜面が広く空く。[全景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-mature-whole-day.png)、[全景390×844](runtime-c6/390-mature-whole-day.png) |
| キャラクターへの愛着 | 7 | 人物と家の尺度は安定し、近景では住人の違いが見える。全景では顔や住人同士の関係が小さく、今回の葉の変更による新たな演技は確認できない。[近景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-close-day.png)、[近景768×1024](runtime-c6/768-flower-close-day.png) |
| 素材の触感 | 6 | 株上端の葉が露出した端を覆い、枝先も植物としてつながった。淡い平面の葉と細長い枝がまだ支柱の印象を残し、葉の厚み・重なり・陰影は原本より弱い。[近景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-close-day.png)、[回転近景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-rotated-flower-close-day.png) |
| 構図と奥行き | 5 | 席の上の小さな庇は回転時にもつながる。一方で直列の株、長い枝、中央の空白、前面の大きな紫殻が目立ち、殻の内側や家を見通す構図が弱い。[全景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-mature-whole-day.png)、[回転全景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-rotated-whole-day.png) |
| 色の楽しさと焦点 | 6 | 一輪と低い四色の花は読める。虹色の高い板列、紫殻、角張った白い道が主花と競合し、小画面では追加葉が地面の色に溶ける。[全景768×1024](runtime-c6/768-mature-whole-day.png)、[近景390×844](runtime-c6/390-flower-close-day.png) |
| 出来事と見返り | 6 | 席へ伸びた枝と葉により「花のそばで休む場所」が前候補より見える。young／分離／再接続で共有冠の有無も読める。ただし席は植物の塊の外側にあり、花庭の内側で暮らす見返りは弱い。[回転近景1280×900](runtime-c6/desktop-rotated-flower-close-day.png)、[分離](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-split-whole-day.png)、[再接続](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-reconnected-whole-day.png) |

六軸すべてが8点未満である。前候補の35/60からは、席へ向かう葉の庇が見えることで「出来事と見返り」を1点上げた。c5の暫定36/60からは据え置く。株上端と席の葉の接続は改善したが、全景・回転・小画面で主要な構図と植物の面の不足が残るためである。

## 確認した12実画面

| viewport | 画面 | 見えたこと |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1280×900 | [成熟全景](runtime-c6/desktop-mature-whole-day.png) | 主花は読めるが、紫殻の占有と中央の空白が強い |
| 1280×900 | [花庭近景](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-close-day.png) | 株上端の葉と、実席へ伸びる枝の接続が改善 |
| 1280×900 | [分離全景](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-split-whole-day.png) | 共有冠と虹色の関係部分が消え、残る3株と低い単独花の差が見える |
| 1280×900 | [再接続全景](runtime-c6/desktop-flower-reconnected-whole-day.png) | 主花と関係部分が戻る。成熟全景と同じ造形へ戻ったことを視認 |
| 1280×900 | [回転全景](runtime-c6/desktop-rotated-whole-day.png) | 直列の株・枝と、殻の大きな面が別角度でも目立つ |
| 1280×900 | [回転花庭近景](runtime-c6/desktop-rotated-flower-close-day.png) | 席上の葉の重なりは見えるが、小さな庇にとどまる |
| 768×1024 | [成熟全景](runtime-c6/768-mature-whole-day.png) | 大きな色面が優先され、花庭の内部は小さい |
| 768×1024 | [花庭近景](runtime-c6/768-flower-close-day.png) | 主花・葉・席の位置関係は残るが、細い枝の間が空く |
| 390×844 | [成熟全景](runtime-c6/390-mature-whole-day.png) | 主花は識別できる。追加葉や住人の暮らしは全島の縮尺で弱くなる |
| 390×844 | [花庭近景](runtime-c6/390-flower-close-day.png) | 席の場所は残るが、葉の面が地面と同化し囲まれた場所に見えにくい |
| 1280×900 | [young全景](runtime-c6/desktop-young-whole-day.png) | 共有冠のない状態の差は明確。若い状態の庭としてのまとまりは薄い |
| 1280×900 | [young花庭近景](runtime-c6/desktop-young-flower-close-day.png) | 3株と単独の低い花が見え、成長前後の高さ・量の連続性が課題として残る |

静止画は住人が実際に着席して立ち去った証拠ではない。席への造形上の接続と、実rigによる利用の検証は分けて扱う。

## 残る美術上の限界

葉の向きと取り付けは直ったが、主花から席までの間を細い長い枝が占めている。席は花庭の縁に近づいたものの、植物に包まれた内側の場所にはなっていない。淡い葉の面も全景と390幅では弱く、さらに葉を数枚増やすだけでは原本との構図の差を縮めにくい。

全島では紫殻が前面を塞ぎ、その内側の家・遊び場・入り江が見えにくい。森の厚み、大樹の実内床とgallery、道の曲がりと家のまとまりが不足する。次のM1工程は[次の制作](next-production.md)に従い、P04の実入口・床・中庭と殻の関係を造形し、同じ入力の全景と回転画面で判断する。これは次工程の方針であり、その未撮影成果への承認ではない。

分離した成熟花が低い単独花へ戻る一方、残る成熟群は高い株を保つ。画像上の成長・単独／群の連続性は未解決として残す。今回の葉・席の改善で、三配置、成長の造形連続性、16／32軒以上への拡張まで完成したとは扱わない。

## 三つの判断を分ける

| 判断 | 結果 | 証拠と範囲 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 美術 | **HOLD：36/60** | 上記12PNGの内部評価。原本に届かず、全島M1の美術受入は未完 |
| 独立理解／安全 | **NOT_EVALUATED：N=0** | 独立観察の逐語回答はない。制作意図を知るエージェントの見え方や実rig検査を、児童の理解・安全・再訪意欲の観察数へ含めない |
| 固定DEV旅程のruntime | **PASS** | [生report](runtime-c6/report.json)は12captures、4canvas selections、4edits、errorsなし。予告取消・分離・収納・再接続を記録 |
| 製品全体のruntime受入 | **PARTIAL** | 新取得、本人保存、実機性能、offline／更新、製品の全経路、最終全島は今回の証拠の範囲外 |

[照合証拠](runtime-c6-proof.json)ではruntimeの1,888入力が固定coreの1,987入力の該当subsetと一致し、両検証内の入力変更はない。アーカイブ時の作業ツリーとの差分も空である。これは範囲を定めた一致であり、二つの検証が同じ全入力集合を使った、あるいは別作業を含む現在以降の全ツリーを保証した、という意味ではない。

実reportの各captureはlive pose検査を記録し、退避・配置不能は0、全ownerの到達可能な接近位置を確認している。歩行に関するこの固定状態の検査は、実席の利用を画像で確認したことや、独立した安全観察の代わりにはしない。headless診断の待ち時間も実機FPSや性能合格へ読み替えない。

body:
# P04 supported corner entrance — production plan

2026-10-12. Read-only design finding, not an implemented or accepted candidate. No runtime, model, benchmark, owner cell, or app was changed. The bounded original-shell candidates in `result.json` remain rejected because they isolate p6 and p9.

## Exact native source

`docs/design/2026-10-10-island-final-3d/varied-world.py:217–244` authors the shell. `shell_point(a,t)` (line 220) creates one tapered half-vault: 28 longitudinal × 72 arch quad cells, with `SOLIDIFY` thickness `.043` at line 233. At uniform `.45`, the skin is `.01935` thick; the complete roof is about `2.1641 × 1.5559 × 1.5552` world units. The original `whole-island.blend` retains this editable surface/modifier and the curves.

Seven transverse ribs are at `t=j/6`, with 25 arch control points and source radii `.068` at the two mouths and `.047` internally (world `.0306` / `.02115`). Seven longitudinal seams lie at `a=iπ/6`, radius `.029` (world `.01305`). Two three-point side runners, `Harbor / shell grown footing[.001]`, have radius `.13` (world `.0585`); these are the actual omitted supports, not vertical posts. `build-scene.py:79–88` makes these smooth AUTO Bezier curves with resolution 12, bevel resolution 3, and filled end caps. They intersect the skin as separate original solids; they are not one welded structural mesh.

Native-05 takes that geometry from `history/native-04/whole-island.blend` through `build-final-scene.py:10–27`; it does not rerun the shell-generation block. `fantasy-colour-world.py:104–112` gives the upper panels their violet material. Preserve those material assignments and the unchanged roof outside the entrance area.

## Entrance location and initial clear profile

Use the bounded A transform only as the starting assembly: source GLTF pivot `(13.9,.89,1.2)` to authored world `(8,.0475,.50)`, uniform `.45`, yaw 0. Blender pivot is `(13.9,-1.2,.89)`; GLTF coordinates are `(Blender X, Blender Z, -Blender Y)`.

Current owners stay p6 `(7,-1)`, p7 `(9,-1)`, play p9 `(8,0)`. p6's only initially reachable approach refs are `(7,-.25)` and `(7.25,-.25)`. On the original sidewall, world `z = 1.211 - 1.494t`; at `z=-.25`, `t≈.978` and the left base is `x≈7.174`. The nominal rear mouth is `z=-.283` (including original rib bounds, about `-.314`). **The desired frontage is only .033 from the nominal end. A usable opening must merge into that open corner; an isolated side window cannot contain the actor.**

The actual `.45` Pokomoko + eight-friend motion envelope is radius `.244069`, height `.550093`, eight retained height bands, from 117 meshes / 99,868 indexed vertices. Its origin is sole-contact ground: `authoredFlowerObstructions.ts:87–100` subtracts measured moving sole extrema and includes walk bob; the obstruction path uses `layout.point(cell,0)`, not the scene's default `.04` visual offset. Exact bands, source motion intervals, capture/build identity and hashes are in `result.json`.

The raw full-width lower bound is `.488139`; allow `.04` each side. Start authoring with a **clear inside-rim profile `.64` wide × `.72` high** (source `1.4222 × 1.6`), centered longitudinally near world `z=-.25`, facing the p6 frontage across X. A semicircular arch has radius `.32`, spring height `.40`; this preliminary profile also allows the shoulder band (`r=.219172`, top `.491556`) plus the local floor rise `≈.0347` and `.04` horizontal/vertical reserve. These are authoring dimensions, not a collision PASS. The shell-side portion reaches to about `z=.07`, hence `t≈.764`; it affects the last two transverse ribs (`t=5/6,1`) and the lower left seams. Do not carry a footer or decorative sill across the opening. Extend the cutting volume below the lowest floor/sole band.

## Minimal real construction

Create a separate derived candidate script, e.g. `build-cove-entrance-variant.py`, reading a copy of the approved native-05 blend. Duplicate only the shell and affected curves/data. On the duplicate, apply the existing Solidify, then use a smooth rounded arch volume facing Blender X to subtract the actual corner aperture with an EXACT Boolean. `varied-world.py:34–42` already supplies `arch_prism`; lines 52–56 demonstrate the project's real solid Boolean method. It is a cutter/profile starting point, not a ready placement. Keep a closed skin/reveal around the new edge, refine/bevel its smooth boundary, and validate the evaluated geometry; do not delete exported triangles.

Author a continuous grown boundary frame following that opening and joining the original rear arch. Turn the remaining left runner upward into the new side jamb/arch, and keep the rear arch's opposite grounded support. Reroute the affected two ribs and bottom seams into this frame so no floating cut ends or ankle-height bars remain. The side opening joins the original mouth, so **do not add a second jamb behind the mouth toward p6's cap roof** merely to imitate a separate rectangular door. Use a continuous curve/connected frame and real roof joints; exact house-triangle clearance must constrain its shape.

Set the new jamb/runner contact from the actual shared dry triangles through the inverse common transform, retaining adequate buried contact and a flush threshold. The existing floor is `Water town / shared frontage court:0`, p9 Y `.025666217`; nearby low terrain is about `-.009`. The bounded probe found ground under every original footing vertex, but did not prove complete load-bearing contact or full-width walking support. First use that existing floor. If the new contact or swept foot corridor falls off it, the minimum additional work is a real shared ground patch/approach in WorldDefinition floors plus corresponding walk refs/edges and visible geometry. It must not create owner grants or be a render-only platform.

## Integration and stop gates

Keep the derived skin, frame and supports under one source pivot and one pure assembly transform. Export it as a separate authored-shell profile (or separate supported variant parts); leave legacy `shell-roof` origin and its false-default delivery path unchanged. Add the actual new shell/frame/runner triangles to a generalized obstruction-root selector: the current flower-only ancestor-name filter would otherwise falsely pass this entrance. Prove the existing home route reaches p6 and p9 and clears the actual use target with all actor bands; prove the actual p6/p7 cap and entry meshes remain separate. Then inspect ready, whole, close, rotation and phone views. A smooth-looking Boolean or locally clear door alone is insufficient.

Do not run `build-final-scene.py` for the variant: lines 34, 45 and 58 overwrite the approved blend, GLB and render. Save the derived candidate, its source hash manifest and views in a new output directory and compare against the unchanged original benchmark. The source identity at this read is:

| Original | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `whole-island.blend` | `d1c7bb078b8f4fafad97862fcd1d691e63cfbcce9c378f21da47ccd167139c2a` |
| `whole-island.glb` | `8398eda9ac084a6e80ed22f1a82670c380b017544a177106325aaa7ba7f8f68d` |
| `whole-island-render.png` | `9de26a7f8a83176df37a7848cae4beea7962eb782247d07cf7e3b970a856f9c6` |
| `varied-world.py` | `9090dbd0923437d449309bc95ffb27a00ec673e3252ca9f98849e8ce53611c22` |
| `build-final-scene.py` | `007cb5dbaee09aa8f235641409729a71409910c9f24c03f139258af47b135234` |

title: P04 corner shell + apron — minimal integration plan

body:
# P04 corner shell + apron — minimal integration plan

2026-10-12. Read-only architecture investigation; app sources remain frozen for c6. The worker owns `docs/design/2026-10-12-authored-cove-entrance/`. Its local candidate is experimental and fixed to the present P04 arrangement. The final source handoff targets `cove-corner-with-apron-v3.blend/.glb` and shell-only `cove-corner-v3.glb`; grounded sockets and a `.284069` half-width floor sweep passed the separate source audit. Trust its final artifact manifest, not earlier v1/v2 geometry. App integration is underway after the c6 boundary was archived. No composed-runtime integration or acceptance is claimed here.

## One-way composition

Add a small domain-level `authoredWorldFrame.ts` coordinator alongside the unchanged `authoredWaterFrame.ts`. Its dependency/order should be:

1. Immutable original base + current state → existing `authoredWaterFrame(state, base)` when water is enabled.
2. `derivePlaces(state, upstreamWorld)` → eligible **input** P04s. Read the play owner from `mainIds` / the real play use target, not `anchorId`: the present P04's anchor is p6, while its play is p9.
3. New pure `deriveAuthoredCovePlan(state, upstreamWorld, inputP04s, sourceProfile)` → explicit eligibility, one shared transform, source identities, support/entry specification and apron patch. No Three.js, SceneLayout, saved geometry, receipt or actor state belongs here.
4. New `composeAuthoredCoveWorld(upstreamWorld, plan)` → append the supported apron floor/bank, walk-only sites and edges; compile once through `compileWorldDefinition`. Return `{ world, waterPlan, covePlan, revision }` from the coordinator, with `revision` describing the **whole** frame.
5. Layout, ordinary final `derivePlaces`, relations, owner placement checks, rendering and committed life all read that returned world. Verify final P04 membership/use identity agrees with the plan; the patch must not bootstrap its own qualification. If adding its route changes the qualifying owners, reject the plan rather than repeatedly feeding final places into composition.

Keep `derivePlaces`, `worldDefinition` and `sceneLayout` free of calls back into this coordinator. Pass plans into layout as data/type-only dependencies. This makes the flow acyclic: frame → water / places / cove composer; renderer → frame / layout. Never compose from an already composed cove frame, or old apron sites can survive removal.

The first production profile should state its proven applicability explicitly. Derive whether the current owners, stages, supply, shore and role-relative positions match it. Do not hardcode that the strings `p6/p7/p9` alone authorize a permanent structure, and do not translate the fixed apron freely with a moved play until that placement has been proved. Moving, storing or separating required inputs must deterministically remove/recompute the entire shell-plus-apron assembly. Ordinary owners remain. A nonapplicable authored-cove plan must not silently fall through to the old enlarged household roof.

Cache by immutable base, enabled features/profile identity and all actual derivation inputs. Existing water cache uses only plots/landmarks/keepsakes; cove additionally depends on `unopened` (`places.ts:193`). Include every other field consumed by its planner, while excluding receipt-only `applied/placeProgress`. Keep bounded cache eviction. Composite revision must include upstream water revision, cove source/profile hash, eligible owner roles/positions/stages and the evaluated transform/patch; a cove-only change cannot be keyed only by `waterPlan.revision`.

## Existing integration points

| File / function | Smallest responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/prototypes/placeQa/authored.tsx`, `AuthoredIsland` | Use the common frame for UI `world`, placement permissions and `applyIntent`; keep passing the immutable base to GrowingWorld. Add explicit opt-in cove delivery, false by default. |
| `worldScene.ts`, `createWorldScene().layout` and `showWaterPreview` | Use the same coordinator for commit and future state. Key ground/preview on composite revision. Existing preview replacement of terrain remains visual; `groundAt()` and life retain committed world. Rename/generalize the preview method if useful, without changing that contract. |
| `sceneLayout.ts`, `sceneLayout/authoredSceneLayout` | Carry `authoredCovePlan`, base and enabled composition options in addition to water plan. Continue mapping the **final composed** floor through `point(cell,0)`, `heightAt`, `logicalAt` and `cellAt`. Do not derive or compose here. |
| `native/authoredGrowingGround.ts`, `buildAuthoredGrowingGround` | Already renders every ground/deck triangle from `layout.world.floors`. Its `buildAuthoredGrowingWater` helper also renders all `world.surfaces`, including a new bank. The apron therefore needs no second render-only floor. |
| `placeGeometry.ts:300`, `placeShellGeometry.ts:43` | Add the authored-cove branch using the matching plan and separately loaded candidate skin/factory. Apply its one common source pivot/rigid-uniform transform, then the renderer offset `(-layout.center, 0, -2)`. Do not recompute PCA/eaves from owners. Keep the existing legacy branch untouched when the new flag is false. |
| `GrowingWorld.tsx` | Load/verify the separate candidate source, pass the factory through object/place builders, publish its candidate/source/composite revision for evidence, and release owned resources. The current native source retains the shell's physical/transmission materials. |

The worker patch currently adds its own district, `native05-cove-corner-shared-apron-v1`, containing one concave ground top, one bank and nine `placement:false` refs; four more refs append to original districts through `siteAdditions`. Its 15 added edges allow only `walk`. Its external graph anchors must resolve against the actual upstream water world. Preserve original districts, floors, anchor floors, acquired sites and join/water edges; keep 73 placement grants. Let compiler support checks reject unsupported edges; also prove full-width floor union separately. Keep `definition.source` as the immutable base identity so the existing coast/source check stays valid; record the extra cove source in the cove plan and composite revision.

The apron GLB is authored evidence of the same patch. Extract/verify its exact triangles through the common transform, then render the world floor once. Do not draw both a coplanar apron GLB top and the evaluated floor, and do not substitute a new rectangular floor. Profile/GLB hashes, transformed skin geometry and patch provenance need one verifiable lineage.

## Preview semantics: preserve the committed world

Retaining committed geometry during a ghost is intentional today, not a general stale-geometry defect. `objectLayer.ts:119` says saved objects persist; tests at `objectLayer.test.ts:151` and `placeGeometry.test.ts:109` preserve their identity. Future places are translucent `.32` overlays (`placeGeometry.ts:330–342`). `worldScene.showWaterPreview` separately swaps visible terrain, hides live visitors and leaves committed pointer support/routes in place.

The missing P04 case is **explicit future disappearance**: `objectLayer.updatePreview` currently renders only changed future places, so an absent future P04 produces no overlay and leaves its old solid shell visible. For the new cove mode, compare committed and future cove-plan revisions/IDs as well as derived-place revisions. Temporarily hide only the affected committed cove visual root while showing its future shell overlay and prospective apron, including the present→absent case. Preserve the actual root/resources and prior visibility; restore them on cancellation/invalid ghost. Do not hide owner houses/play, replace `layer.places`, call life.sync with future state, or install the prospective world as actor support. Preview shells remain outside the committed `placeRoot` obstruction input. This is a scoped presentation extension, not a new physical preview contract.

`objectLayer.ts:267` currently enables future composition only when a water plan exists; use the common enabled-frame context so cove-only mode works. `worldScene` preview keys must likewise use composite revision. A future model rendered from that frame and the subsequently confirmed frame must have identical source transforms and apron geometry. Keep the existing static-preview actor hiding and committed ground picking behavior.

## Actor obstruction integration

The flower-specific activation and filter gates need generalizing; changing only the triangle filter is insufficient:

1. `growingLife.ts:95`: `authored-flower-support` existence currently decides whether the physical guard runs.
2. `authoredFlowerObstructions.ts:128`, `stockIndex`: ancestor names admit only three flower roots.
3. Same file, `authoredFlowerWalkSet:280`: `stockCount` counts only `authored-flower-owned-stock`, and zero returns unrestricted.

Also replace the stock-only conditions in `GrowingLife.playExit` and its drop-origin handling; otherwise a cove-only scene can still bypass reachable exits. Use one explicit eligible-obstruction-root convention/helper for current flower roots plus the new shell/frame/runner root. Preserve flower `stockCount` diagnostics if needed, but drive guard activation/early return from actual eligible roots/triangles. Keep the new root recognizable through GardenGeometry batching (`nativePart`/ownership boundary as appropriate). Run the same measured `.45` actor bands, edge sweeps and final-pose guards on the final composed world. Do not index the supporting apron top as an overhead obstruction: it is the floor. A cove with no flowers must still be checked, while legacy scenes remain unchanged.

## Required focused verification

- Domain/frame: actual candidate + **water-composed** world; unchanged old floor/anchor/placement/join/water data, exactly scoped additions, valid edge support, no copied state mutations, deterministic revision/cache. Unsupported/profile-mismatched arrangements produce no cove patch.
- Source parity/integration: exact candidate source hash, common shell/support transform, GLB-apron versus evaluated-floor triangle parity, no doubled floor, all required owner approaches and p9 use reachable through actual source obstacles. Local pre-water route success is insufficient.
- Edit lifecycle through `applyIntent`: required-home/play/supply move, store, separation and restore; entire dependent shell/apron/refs/edges disappear or recompute; original owners/grants remain; reconnect restores exact plan. Model on the command/preview tests in `native/authoredWaterIntegration.test.ts:88–134`.
- Preview/cancel/commit: changed and removed P04 visual roots match the future plan, cancel restores original visibility/resources, canonical world/picking/actors stay committed, confirmed geometry equals prediction, receipt-only state changes retain the layer.
- Life: cove-only and mixed flower+cove fixtures, actual source triangles included, walk→play→exit and occupied-edit/carry/drop/cancel remain safe without false use receipts. Follow existing `authoredFlowerLife.test.ts` behavior without replacing its flower cases. Whole/close/ready/rotation/phone visual gates follow source/contact proof.

title: P04 native shell — bounded numerical planning
label: native shell — bounded numerical planning
body:
# P04 native shell — bounded numerical planning

2026-10-12. Read-only investigation; app sources and original art unchanged. No browser render or acceptance claim.

The exact original probe and raw result are archived here. Its constants name the original `/private/tmp/sansu-authored-cove-plan` output and c5 temporary capture paths. To replay after those temporary paths are removed, change only those input/output constants: the same c5 report and screenshot bytes are retained under `../c5-shape/`, and choose a new output directory. App and model inputs are identified by SHA in `result.json`; a different source revision needs its own result rather than replacing this record.

`result.json` records exact source/input hashes, unchanged-input closure, the c5 capture and build identity, actor-envelope provenance, and compact raw geometry/navigation results. The source is native-05 GLB SHA `8398eda9ac084a6e80ed22f1a82670c380b017544a177106325aaa7ba7f8f68d`.

The current fixed state has p6 `(7,-1)`, p7 `(9,-1)`, and play p9 `(8,0)`. p9's physical floor is Y `0.025666217`, `Water town / shared frontage court:0`. P04's l32 is an individual bowl; the water-composed frame cuts only the northern l20–l24 group. Consequently this bounded P04 dry-floor probe uses the unmodified base world's same local triangles and graph. It does not re-prove the whole composed world.

## Source architecture

The native shell/ribs/seams are `4.8092 × 3.4575 × 3.4560` source units. Uniform `.45` gives `2.1641 × 1.5559 × 1.5552` world units. Both omitted `shell grown footing` curves have 295 source vertices; together with the roof there are 63,440 actual source triangles. All are transformed together from pivot `(13.9,.89,1.2)`, preserving their source joints. No unrelated roof or new posts were used.

The footings are gently rising curved runners. Sampling every footing vertex establishes dry ground beneath the observed samples, not a guarantee that every triangular interior is supported or that the entire underside rests on a plane. Candidate A's lower band has floor offsets about `-.0048…+.0655`; each side has 52/64 sampled vertices within 25 mm of the existing floor. Full physical support remains a later geometry gate.

## Bounded candidates

Coordinates are authored world coordinates. Renderer X subtracts `layout.center`; renderer Z subtracts 2. All candidates have X=8 and Y=.0475.

| Candidate | Z | Uniform scale | Yaw | Unsupported footing vertices | House triangle intersections | Removed walking refs | Reachable approaches p6 / p7 / p9 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| A | .50 | .45 | 0° | 0 | 0 | 39 | 0 / 7 / 0 |
| B | .40 | .45 | -15° | 0 | 0 | 32 | 0 / 6 / 0 |
| C | .50 | .40 | 0° | 0 | 0 | 27 | 0 / 7 / 0 |

All three are rejected. A is a plausible low silhouette only: default-camera rays from both cap roofs have 0/45 occluded samples per home, p6's actual blue entry has 3/41 covered and p7's 0/41. This treats transmission as geometric occlusion and cannot replace a rendered whole/close view. At p9 and its straight front approach, source underside rays have roughly 1.16–1.49 world Y clearance. The existing actor envelope is radius .244069 and height .550093.

The fatal issue is approach topology: p6 initially has only `(7,-.25)` and `(7.25,-.25)` home-reachable approach refs. The lowered source sidewall/runners block them. p9's front center refs `(8,.75)`, `(8,1)`, `(8,1.25)` still stand on dry ground and are clear to the play target, but are isolated from home after the shell is included. A shell ignored by the flower-only triangle selector would falsely pass; this probe explicitly routes all shell/runners through an in-memory named wrapper to reuse the exact obstruction kernel. Final implementation must generalize eligible obstruction roots.

## Next requirement

Do not implement candidate A as finished P04 or simply lift it again. First design a real entrance from p6's frontage and the island path to p9. Either author a supported side opening in the original shell family or provide a dry approach around an open end with the full actor band supported and clear of the runners. If existing ground is insufficient, author that shared support/approach into WorldDefinition floors, explicit walk refs/edges, and source geometry; do not invent planting rights or a renderer-only platform. Retain current ownership, maturation, P04 supply/use conditions and input positions.

The minimal pure assembly plan must therefore output the shared source transform, support contacts, entry/approach refs and obstruction geometry together, rejecting a candidate when any current owner or p9 use target becomes unreachable. Preview and committed world must read that same result. Whole, close, rotation and phone renders follow a feasible plan; these numerical findings are not art acceptance.

title: 仕様同期と差分レビュー
label: 仕様同期と差分レビュー
body:
# 仕様同期と差分レビュー

対象は、制作中のauthored P05で原本の枝先に葉を接合し、現在の実座席へ届く枝を庭の縁にする変更。前段の太株・一輪の主花と実通行判定を維持する。

## Doc Sync Report

- Change type: UI／3D美術。所有・経済・学習・保存の規則変更ではない。
- SSOT update needed: Yes。[原本部品と所有の契約](../../product/island-native-owned-art.md)を実装前に更新した。
- 実接合、原本長の範囲、現在の同じplaceのseat、予告と確定の共通生成、移動／収納／分離時の再計算、実meshによる通行・座位・退出を契約へ追加した。
- [親仕様01](../../product/01_app_spec.md)、[遊びの規則52](../../product/52_growing_island_game_spec.md)、[保存仕様13](../../product/13_data_storage_migration_spec.md)は変更しない。取得・価格・P05の成立条件・時計・所有ID・本人保存schema・学習を変更していないため。
- [検証matrix](../../ai/verification_matrix.md)の花庭行を適用する。今回、新しい検証免除や合格基準は設けない。
- 同じ正本には次工程P04の低い殻・入口・共有床の制作契約と検証対象も先に追記した。これはc6で検証済みの花庭とは別の未完工程であり、c6の結果へ含めない。
- ADRとdurable memoryの追加なし。既存の「美術と遊びが同じ世界を読む」方針の具体化であり、新しい恒久方針や保存互換の判断ではない。
- 美術タスク、共有キュー、完了履歴へ今回の限定された実装・検証結果と残件を同期する。包括ゴールとM1は完了へ移さない。

## Diff Review Report

- Safety: 対象コードの確認では新しい重大な問題なし。実住人の姿勢・歩行検査と最終browser結果は[検証記録](verification.md)へ分ける。独立した児童の理解／安全はN=0。
- Spec alignment: 原本のmesh、長さ、実接合点を保ち、株や席を自動移動しない。高すぎる席・届かない席・若い／未接続の群には枝を作らない。
- Tone: 新しい子ども向け文言、競争、失敗への評価は追加していない。
- Over-change: 枝葉のfactory、現在のseat入力、候補IDと関連検査へ限定。先行作業の太株／歩行対応を取り消さず、同時進行の内部ポータルのファイルは編集しない。

独立したコード確認では追加の修正事項を認めなかった。形の確認は、接合頂点・剛体変換・実座面への投影・移動と収納の再計算を検査し、見た目の受入は[実画面の評価](art-review.md)へ分離する。テストPASSを庭の構図や全島美術の合格にはしない。

title: 全島M1で次に直す構造
label: 全島で次に直す構造
body:
# 全島M1で次に直す構造

これは花庭c6に続く制作工程。[別の編集可能な低い殻・入口・共有床](../2026-10-12-authored-cove-entrance/README.md)を制作し、本体接続を進める。三配置や拡張へ工程を繰り上げず、[島構築方針](../../product/island-construction-strategy.md)の全島一例を続ける。以下の先行数値調査は不採用案の根拠として保持する。

## 入り江の殻を、実際に使う内庭から組み立てる

採用原本の低い殻は湾の端に接地し、前景の家が独立して読める。現在の実全景では、殻が家を広く覆う高架屋根になり、内側と入口が見えにくい。

現コード `placeShellGeometry.ts` は家とあそびばを含むmainIds全体の外接寸法から殻を伸縮する。入口全体の最高床から1.40上げ、原本の上下を.45へ圧縮し、全plotへ別の支柱を立てる。この支柱の上端は実殻面に接合していない。原本kitは殻・肋骨・継ぎ目を含むが、原本の両裾のfootingを含まない。

同じ32所有物でのP04は家p6 (7,−1)、p7 (9,−1)、あそびばp9 (8,0)を主材料とし、水源はl32 (8,−2)。原本の内庭の固定位置へ殻を戻すだけでは、この所有配置と一致しない。

次は、実あそびばの利用点、家の入口、到達済みの乾いた床から、内庭の開口と両裾を一緒に選ぶ組立計画を作る。家の外接箱を全部覆う形へ強制せず、原本の殻と実footingを同じ尺度で配置する。見た目だけの床planeや無所有の原本席を足さない。現groundで成立しない場合は、追加床・支持・歩行辺を同じworld revisionに含めてから描画する。確定と予告はこの一つの計画を使う。

守るものは73取得権、全ownerの座標・成熟・style、水供給と到達、無料の分離／再接続、p9の実利用。検証には、両裾の接地、肋骨との接合、家の見通し、入口から実利用点への通行と退出、全景／回転／湾近景／390幅を加える。現在の一般的な頭上余白や材質テストだけでこれらを証明したことにしない。

### 先行数値調査：低く置くだけでは通れない

[原本三角形による限定調査](cove-plan-diagnostic/README.md)を保存した。原本の殻・肋骨・両裾を同じpivotから一様`.45`で置くと、幅2.164／高さ1.556／奥行1.555の低い内庭になる。現在のp9の近くへ置いた3候補は、両裾の頂点サンプルに乾いた床があり、家の実triangleとの交差もなかった。ただし、三角形の内部を含む全面の接地まで証明したものではない。

実actorの部位別余白と、殻・両裾の全63,440 trianglesを経路判定へ含めると、候補Aは39、回転Bは32、小型Cは27の歩行点が使えなくなった。どれも家p6とあそびばp9への到達が切れるため不採用。p9前方の床が見た目に空いていても、島の経路から孤立する。花庭だけを選ぶ現行の障害物selectorへ殻を渡さないまま検査すると、この問題を見落とす。

次の具体的な制作単位は、**p6の前と島の道からp9へ入れる実開口と支持された接近路**。原本系列の殻に側面入口を作るか、開いた端へ回り込む実床を構成する。床が不足する場合は、その支持・床面・歩行点・辺を同じworld revisionへ追加し、植える権利は増やさない。上へ浮かせ直すことや、殻を衝突検査から外すことは解決にしない。この数値調査はc5の実rig測定と同じ局所床を使った制作判断であり、c6の描画結果や実編集の合格へ数えない。

[原本の編集手順と入口案](cove-plan-diagnostic/entrance-production.md)も保存した。p6の接近路は既存開口端から約`.033`なので、孤立した小窓では足りない。原本の厚い殻から続く丸い角の入口、実接地した支え、既存の肋骨へ連続する枠を別の編集候補に造形する。入口内寸`.64 × .72`は実rigから決めた初期値で、通行合格ではない。採用原本のblend／GLB／全景画像は上書きしない。

[本体接続の調査](cove-plan-diagnostic/integration-production.md)では、水庭の組立後に共通のauthored frameで殻・共有床・経路を一つの計画へまとめる。sceneLayoutやderivePlacesの内側で世界を再帰的に作らない。予告中に現在の物を残す既存仕様は保持し、殻と追加床の変更・消失だけを現在と将来の比較として明示する。住人の実世界は確定まで変えない。殻のみの島でも実三角形を経路／poseへ含め、収納・分離時は追加床の除去と住人の復帰まで検査する。

## 花庭と、島全体の残件

花庭は席を包む葉の重なりを同じ原本の3Dで実装し、固定c6の全旅程と回帰を通過した。二回の粗形比較で、枝葉の支持と小さな庇は改善したが、庭に包まれる構図は未到達。葉の追加だけで三回目へ進めず、次の再制作では列／囲いの形の選択と植物の面を設計し直す。葉の面の厚み、直列配置の構図、単独成熟と接続群の連続性は別に残る。全島では殻の圧迫、裸の丘と角張った白道、森の薄さ、大樹の内床・回廊が引き続き未達。局所の技術検査や戸数を全島の採用の代わりにしない。

title: 花庭の枝先と、席を包む縁
label: 花庭の枝先と、席を包む縁
body:
# 花庭の枝先と、席を包む縁

制作候補 `native05-authored-flower-garden-v3`（先行粗形v2を下記へ保存）。全島M1の制作途中で、包括ゴールは[島構築方針](../../product/island-construction-strategy.md)を維持する。[採用native-05](../2026-10-10-island-final-3d/README.md)と[前候補の実画面](../2026-10-11-authored-flower-garden/contact-sheet.html)から、露出した三叉端と花庭の外にあるベンチの関係を直す。

## 制作契約

- 転写するもの：原本の広葉、枝の曲がりと実接合点、太株と一輪の比例、花の下と縁に暮らす空間。
- 転写しないもの：所有の追加、所有物の自動移動、離れた席へ引き伸ばす枝、全景の不足を補う背景花。
- 同じ32所有物・8軒の保存済み合成入力を使う。新取得・本人保存・32軒拡張の証拠にはしない。
- 体験：「隣の花が育つ → 枝先に葉が広がる → 近くの席が庭の縁に包まれる」。現在のP05条件・所有・時計・住人・実床と利用先を保持する。

三叉の実終点へ原本の広葉を接合する。現在の同じplaceのseat use targetに、原本の上枝が届くときだけ剛体回転・移動で伸ばす。冠を引き伸ばさず、株の位置も変えない。移動予告と確定は同じ生成処理を読み、収納や分離で枝がなくなる。新しい葉と枝も実triangleによる通行・座位・退出検査へ含める。

## 検証と受入

[採用原本・前候補と最新12実画面の比較](contact-sheet.html)を保存した。固定c6のcoreは601 files／5,232 tests、花庭の全旅程は12画面・4株の実canvas選択・予告取消／分離／収納／再接続の4編集がPASS。[1,888入力と固定coreの照合](runtime-c6-proof.json)も一致した。[既存4回帰](regressions-c6-proof.json)も元編集6項目／7画面、水庭6項目／14画面、通常Growing8旅程／22画面・40回答、classic32がPASS。全段階でcoreの1,987入力が前後一致し、[検証記録](verification.md)へ範囲をまとめた。

美術、独立理解／安全、runtimeは別判定とし、まだ採用済みとはしない。美術は36/60 HOLD、独立観察N=0、対象runtimeはPASS。本人保存への切替・offline／更新・実機・性能と全島完成は未完。[仕様同期と差分レビュー](doc-sync.md)も受入と分けて残す。

前候補c4の全旅程が一時領域にのみ残っていたため、[12画面と4操作](../2026-10-11-authored-flower-garden/runtime-c4/report.json)と[既存4回帰の再検査](../2026-10-11-authored-flower-garden/c4-recovered-inspection.json)を保存した。水庭の元集計FAILは結果の文字列を辞書として読んだエラーで、元FAILを保持して個別PASSを別に確認した。過去c4の証拠を今回のv3へ流用しない。

## 先行粗形c5を比較して変更すること

[実画面2枚](c5-shape/report.json)と[固定core](c5-core/report.json)はPASS。原本14部品の再抽出も一致した。しかし実席上の葉は外側を向き、休む場所を包む面がまだ弱い。内部の暫定美術評価は36/60 HOLDで、露出した株上端も残る。これは制作前進の記録で、全画面旅程や全島美術の受入ではない。

v3では枝終端の葉を座面側へ向け、枝の途中と終端の葉が重なる面を作った。株の上端も同じ原本葉の実接合で覆う。平面投影で実座面の中心が葉の内側に入り、実住人が座る・退出する高さをfocused検査した。原本の比例、所有の位置、実床、主花を保持する。

株の切り口と小さな庇は改善したが、長い支えと薄い葉の面、庭に包まれる構図は未達。二回の粗形比較を受け、葉の枚数を足すだけの反復を止める。[次工程](next-production.md)ではP04の低い殻・実入口・内庭を一緒に扱う。原本の殻を低く置くだけの3候補は、家とあそびばへの経路を切るため数値調査で不採用とした。見た目だけの接地や頭上余白を、暮らせる場所の成立に読み替えない。
